title: search hide label only if name states context
rule: Search: visually hide the label only if the accessible name states the search context (“Hae sivustolta” / “Hae toimipisteitä”). Placeholder is visual extra. Clear control appears once there is a query. Skip search on tiny single-page tools. Placeholder/label lock: this is not a general placeholder-as-label pass.
pass_when: If the search label is visually hidden, the accessible name states context; placeholder is extra; clear appears once there is a query; tiny single-page tools may omit search.
fail_when: Visually hidden search label with a generic name that does not state context; or ordinary non-search fields hide the label citing this.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: NL header-search placeholder exception as this context-name row; GOLD search placement.
